title: Consolidate Hunch documentation via templated grounding blocks
context: Hunch (Engineering Memory) documentation was duplicated across multiple agent/IDE configuration files (.cursor/rules, .windsurf/rules, copilot-instructions, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), making it difficult to maintain consistency and update guidance.
decision: Introduced template-based grounding blocks (e.g., `<!-- hunch:template 2 -->`) to replace verbose inline documentation. Condensed the full moment-by-moment tool guidance into a shorter reference form while preserving essential structure and tool names.
consequences: Single source of truth for Hunch tool guidance across all IDE/agent configurations
Reduced documentation size and improved readability in each config file
Easier maintenance: update template once, regenerate all files
Users still have access to core tool names and invoke patterns in each context
Detailed tool reference (when to call what, by moment) now delegated to external source or template definition
alternatives_rejected: Keep verbose inline documentation in each file (maintenance burden, inconsistency risk)
Remove Hunch guidance entirely from IDE/agent configs (discoverability loss)
Move all documentation to external reference with no inline summary (higher friction for tool adoption)
